provenance.method: ran the reference detect_file_importer over a synthetic corpus
provenance.why_here: a build worktree has no Python environment and cannot run the reference

routing_contract.rule: detect_file_importer iterates the registry in insertion order and returns the FIRST importer whose detect() returns True
routing_contract.file_patterns_are_NOT_the_predicate: file_patterns is DISPLAY metadata shown by --list-importers. detect() is the predicate and they disagree: six importers advertise *.zip but discriminate by ARCHIVE CONTENT, and obsidian advertises *.md but detect() returns False for any FILE — it requires a DIRECTORY plus .obsidian/, logseq/, or >=3 non-hidden .md files. A native port that built detection from file_patterns would be wrong for every importer.
